products.name: Walli
products.summary: Walli is a household year calendar. The whole year sits on one wall so a family can see what's coming, together — not a week agenda you have to hunt through.
abilities: See the year at a glance. The year is the product.
One wall for the household, not one calendar per person.
Plans as stamps on the year, not a dense agenda.
Invite people onto the same year.
peopleTexture: People on the year, contacts on the phone, one household.
Walli Calendar is a household year. The people on it are the point.
Your address book never has to leave the phone.
A household calendar should not mean three copies of Dad.
